reason: A strawberry cheesecake matcha or a halva latte with torched meringue nearby is exactly the kind of thing I'd detour for and post when I'm walking the West Village on a Saturday. I'd try one or two of the signatures, but I'm only around on weekends so it won't be a habit.
objection: I don't know if the drinks actually look as good as they sound, and it's tucked inside another bar's space so it may not have the vibe or light for a good photo. Six days a week also makes me wonder if I'd show up on the day it's closed.
